# Jurassic English™

> Jurassic English™ is a literature-based academic English and critical-thinking framework, published by World Wise Learning. It helps students, parents, schools and learning centres build academic English, critical thinking, literature-based reasoning and IELTS-aligned speaking confidence. The site is in English and Vietnamese.

Jurassic English is an independent education provider. It is not endorsed by or affiliated with IELTS, Cambridge University Press & Assessment, the British Council or IDP. Only an authorised IELTS test produces an official IELTS score.

## Main offers

- [School framework](https://jurassicenglish.com/school-framework): a coherent literature-based English curriculum for schools and centres — curriculum alignment, teacher consistency and visible portfolio evidence.
- [Student Academy](https://jurassicenglish.com/student-academy): for students and parents; a five-level, literature-based academic reasoning pathway to read deeper, speak smarter, write stronger and defend ideas in English.
- [IELTS Speaking coaching, ages 9–18](https://jurassicenglish.com/young-learners-speaking/): IELTS-aligned 1-to-1 and small-group speaking coaching that starts with a Live Speaking Baseline, 15–20 minutes live on Google Meet with an assessor. Vietnamese: https://jurassicenglish.com/vi/luyen-noi-ielts/
- [Jurassic AI Speaking](https://jurassicenglish.com/ai-speaking): for adult learners; typed IELTS-style Speaking practice for Parts 1–3 with a practice estimate, evidence from the learner's own words and one priority to work on next. Practice feedback only, not an official IELTS score. Vietnamese: https://jurassicenglish.com/ai-speaking/vi
- [One-to-one IELTS Speaking sessions](https://jurassicenglish.com/ai-speaking/one-to-one): guided practice with Mr. Jay and the Jurassic English teaching team, designed to leave learners with a clear independent-practice priority.
- [Business English for tech teams](https://jurassicenglish.com/companies): AI-assisted business and technical English for Vietnam's tech and export teams (Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi); client-ready communication for engineers, measured in CEFR/IELTS gains.

## IELTS Speaking guidance

- [IELTS Speaking resource hub](https://jurassicenglish.com/insights): open guidance on evidence-led feedback, typed-practice limits and the path from diagnosis to guided practice.
- [What should I fix first in IELTS Speaking?](https://jurassicenglish.com/insights/what-to-fix-first-in-ielts-speaking): identify evidence, choose one useful priority and try another answer independently.
- [What can typed IELTS-style practice assess?](https://jurassicenglish.com/insights/what-typed-speaking-practice-can-assess): explains what typed answers can show and why pronunciation still requires audio.
- [From speaking diagnostic to one-to-one lesson](https://jurassicenglish.com/insights/from-speaking-diagnostic-to-one-to-one-lesson): connects diagnostic evidence to guided practice, reassessment and transfer.
- [About Nathaniel Jay Adams](https://jurassicenglish.com/about/nathaniel-jay-adams): founder background, education work and editorial responsibility.

## Curriculum and method

- [Framework](https://jurassicenglish.com/framework): integrates the Jurassic Thinking Cycle™, CEFR progression and ecocentric pedagogy into a structured school curriculum from Pre-A1 to C1.
- [Methodology](https://jurassicenglish.com/methodology): the four-stage reasoning architecture behind Jurassic English™ lessons — analyze, evaluate, justify and reflect.
- [Curriculum levels compared](https://jurassicenglish.com/series/compare): five levels, ages 4–14+, Pre-A1 to C1, with a syllabus page for each level.
- [Jurassic Thinking Cycle™](https://jurassicenglish.com/thinking-cycle/compare): the four reasoning stages side by side.
- [CEFR alignment](https://jurassicenglish.com/cefr-alignment): how the framework maps to CEFR, CEFR-V and MOET 2030 national standards.
- [Teacher standards](https://jurassicenglish.com/teacher-standards): qualification standards, methodology preparation and delivery governance.
- [Knowledge hub](https://jurassicenglish.com/knowledge): framework, methodology, CEFR alignment, teacher standards and parent answers in one place.

## For schools and centres

- [Curriculum Coherence Audit Sprint](https://jurassicenglish.com/audit-sprint): a focused curriculum review — alignment, materials, teacher practice, progression logic and an implementation roadmap.
- [Pilot programme](https://jurassicenglish.com/pilot-programme): a structured 6–8 week pilot pathway for schools, academies and training centres.
- [Discovery call](https://jurassicenglish.com/discovery): a structured consultation on curriculum alignment, teacher training, school licensing or academic English implementation.
